Maybe they'll say, "Show me analytics."
And the agent with the LLM is going to
decide which tools to call using the MCP

a tool. And then the server is going to
return the tool results with a UI a

reference that was referenced from the
server, and then the host is going to
render the app inside a sandboxed
iframe. So, the user at that point is
able to interact with the iframe in the
host, and there's really a nice
separation there between the two. And
then the app can call back to the server
back and forth so that you have this
live interaction experience. And then
